text: Welcome to the private collection of my esteemed master, Baron Frestek.
zh: 欢迎来到我尊敬的主人——弗雷斯泰克男爵的私人收藏馆。

text: What brings a noble adventurer like yourself to a collection like this?
zh: 是什么风把您这样尊贵的冒险者吹到了这收藏馆来？

text: Would you care to view the exceedingly rare, and quite costly, items?
zh: 您可愿一观这些极为稀有、也颇为昂贵的藏品？

text: Or are you perhaps interested in contributing something to the collection?
zh: 又或者，您有意为收藏添上一件藏品？

text: Welcome to the private collection of my esteemed master, Baron Frestek.
zh: 欢迎来到我尊敬的主人——弗雷斯泰克男爵的私人收藏馆。

text: How may I be of service to you?
zh: 有什么我可以为您效劳的？

text: What items does the Baron collect?
zh: 男爵都收藏些什么？

text: How may I contribute to the collection?
zh: 我要怎样才能为收藏出份力？

text: I want to add something to the collection.
zh: 我想为收藏添一件东西。

text: There's nothing I want, right now.
zh: 我现在没什么想要的。

text:
Very well.
Here's a list of all the items in the Baron's possession.
zh:
好的。
这是男爵现有全部藏品的清单。

text:
Well then.
Wishing you all the best on your journey.
zh:
那好。
祝您旅途一切顺利。

text: Here you will find all manner of rare weapons, armors, and artifacts that Baron Frestek acquired during his travels.
zh: 在这里，您能见到弗雷斯泰克男爵游历各地时收得的各式稀有武器、防具与神器。

text:
You should know that he is an exceptionally meticulous collector.
If he hears of a rare item, he notes it to his list and simply must obtain it.
zh:
您要知道，他是一位极其严谨的收藏家。
只要听说某件稀有物品，他就会记进清单，非到手不可。

text: By now, it is well known that Frestek pays a correspondingly high price for any item he does not yet possess.
zh: 如今人尽皆知，凡是弗雷斯泰克尚未入手的物品，他都愿意出相称的高价。

text: The Baron keeps a list of items he has at least heard of or read about.
zh: 男爵有一份清单，凡是他听闻或读到过的物品都记录在册。

text:
These items may be given to me.
It is my duty to examine them, assess their value, and store them appropriately within the collection.
zh:
这些物品可以交给我。
检验、估价并将它们妥善收入收藏，正是我的职责。

text: Should you bring me an item the Baron does not yet possess, you will be given an appropriate reward.
zh: 若您带来男爵尚未拥有的物品，便会获得相应的酬谢。

text:
You already made a small contribution to the collection. 
Please accept this gift in recognition of your efforts.
zh:
您已为收藏做出了一点贡献。
请收下这份礼物，聊表谢意。

text:
Your efforts to contribute to the collection have already become known around here.
These rare stones are yours as a token of our appreciation.
zh:
您为收藏所做的贡献，在这里已传为佳话。
这些稀有的宝石便赠予您，以表谢忱。

text:
Your contribution to the Baron's collection is truly exceptional.
This gift is bestowed by the Baron himself.
zh:
您对男爵收藏的贡献着实非凡。
这份礼物是男爵亲自赐下的。

text:
I must admit, I did not believe anyone capable of contributing so greatly.
You have truly surprised me.
zh:
我必须承认，我从不曾相信有人能做出如此巨大的贡献。
您着实令我惊讶。

text:
This is among the rarest treasures in the Baron's collection.
Please, accept it.
zh:
这是男爵收藏中最为稀有的珍宝之一。
请您收下。

text:
I can hardly believe my eyes.
The Baron's collection is now complete.
zh:
我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
男爵的收藏如今圆满了。

text:
Nothing remains...
Every item has been examined, appraised, and placed in its proper spot.
zh:
再无遗漏……
每一件藏品都已检验、估价，并归于其位。

text: Please accept this badge. It reflects your efforts and the Baron's gratitude.
zh: 请收下这枚徽章。它凝聚着您的辛劳，也承载着男爵的谢意。
